//_note_1: BM DOMAIN ROW TEMPLATE — 26 columns for the proposed SDTM Biomarker Context domain.
//_note_2: One row per biomarker claim. One BM row covers many LB rows (same assay, same entity).
//_note_3: BM carries NO subject data, NO values, NO dates — it is context only.

//_provenance_codes.T: tBCO — assay specification (fixed by the assay, identical for every record made under it)
//_provenance_codes.R: rBCO — run record (produced by this patient's run)
//_provenance_codes.K: BiomarkerKB — the biomarker's own description (from the BMKB record)
//_provenance_codes.N: New — proposed here; no CDISC variable and no external source
//_provenance_codes.S: Study / CRF / derived — protocol, case report form, or computed

//_proposed_domain_note: BM is NOT in SDTMIG v3.4. It is a PHUSE Omics working group proposal. Until CDISC standardises it, submission may use a custom domain prefix (X/Y/Z).

row.//_field_notes_column_order: Order matches the BM sheet in Troponin_I_SDTM.xlsx. Variable names are SDTM-compliant (8-char limit).

BMID.label: Biomarker Context Identifier
BMID.description: Identifier for this biomarker claim. What other records and documents cite. Typically derived from BiomarkerKB canonical ID.

BMVER.label: Biomarker Context Version
BMVER.description: Version of the claim. Changing a rule, role or population increments this rather than overwriting what was previously asserted.

BMENTNM.label: Entity Name
BMENTNM.description: The molecule or feature being used as a biomarker. From BMKB assessed_biomarker_entity.recommended_name, stripped of surrounding quotes.
BMENTNM.mapping_note: Strip surrounding quotes (e.g., "'Troponin I, Cardiac Muscle'" → 'Troponin I, cardiac muscle')

BMENTID.label: Entity Identifier
BMENTID.description: Ontology CURIE for the entity: UniProtKB, HGNC, ChEBI.

BMENTTP.label: Entity Type
BMENTTP.description: Class of entity: protein, gene, metabolite, variant, clinical, pathway, phenotype.

BMCVTERM.label: Controlled Vocabulary Term
BMCVTERM.description: The biomarker as a controlled-vocabulary statement: {Change} {Aspect} of {EntityType} {EntityID}. This is NOT the same as LBTESTCD.

BMROLE.label: BEST Biomarker Role
BMROLE.description: BEST biomarker role: DIAGNOSTIC, PROGNOSTIC, PREDICTIVE, MONITORING, SAFETY, SUSCEPTIBILITY/RISK, PHARMACODYNAMIC/RESPONSE. Uppercased from BMKB. Only interpretable alongside BMCOND.

BMCOND.label: Target Condition or Exposure
BMCOND.description: The disease or exposure the role is scoped to. Use the STUDY CONTEXT condition, not the BMKB example condition (which may differ).

BMCONDID.label: Condition Identifier
BMCONDID.description: Ontology CURIE for the condition: DOID, MONDO.

BMASSAY.label: Assay Profile Reference
BMASSAY.description: The assay the claim depends on. Decision thresholds are assay-specific and do not transfer.

BMNAM.label: Assay Manufacturer
BMNAM.description: Vendor of the assay named in BMASSAY.

BMMETHOD.label: Measurement Method
BMMETHOD.description: The analytical technique, not the product. Putting a vendor assay name here is a common error.

BMSPEC.label: Specimen Type
BMSPEC.description: The matrix the biomarker is measured in: SERUM, PLASMA, WHOLE BLOOD, URINE. Constant for the biomarker-assay pair; decision thresholds do not transfer between matrices.

BMSRCDOM.label: Source Domain
BMSRCDOM.description: The SDTM domain holding the measurements this claim describes.
BMSRCDOM.source: Assigned (always LB for biomarker lab results)

BMSRCVAR.label: Source Identifying Variable
BMSRCVAR.description: The variable in that domain used to select the relevant records.

BMSRCVAL.label: Source Identifying Value
BMSRCVAL.description: The value of BMSRCVAR that selects the relevant LB records. Must match the actual LBTESTCD in the LB domain.

BMSRCVR2.label: Source Identifying Variable 2
BMSRCVR2.description: A second variable used to narrow the selection. Needed when BMSRCVAL alone selects records from more than one assay.

BMSRCVL2.label: Source Identifying Value 2
BMSRCVL2.description: The value of BMSRCVR2 that narrows the selection to a specific assay.
BMSRCVL2.source: Assigned — must match SUPPLB QVAL where QNAM=ASSAYNAM

BMBCOID.label: BioCompute Object Identifier
BMBCOID.description: Identifier of the tBCO (IEEE 2791-2020) holding the decision rule and assay specification. Authoritative; BMRULE is only its human-readable rendering.

BMRULE.label: Interpretation or Decision Rule (text)
BMRULE.description: Human-readable rendering of the rule identified by BMBCOID. For reading, not for execution.
BMRULE.example: Value > 0.04 ng/mL AND rise or fall >= 30% within 6 h

BMEVID.label: Evidence Reference
BMEVID.description: Citation supporting the claim: PMID, DOI, internal report. Evidence only; who asserted it is BMASSRT.

BMASSRT.label: Asserting Party
BMASSRT.description: Who asserted this biomarker context: sponsor, committee, regulator or consortium.

BMASSDTC.label: Assertion Date
BMASSDTC.description: When the claim at this BMVER was asserted, ISO 8601 date.
BMASSDTC.source: Study metadata (date of biomarker review board decision)

//_fill_order: 1. K fields from BMKB record → 2. T fields from tBCO → 3. N fields assigned by skill → 4. S fields from study context
//_condition_mismatch_warning: Set BMCOND/BMCONDID from the STUDY CONTEXT condition - never inherit one from a template or copy it from an example record.
